Cell charging and upgrading grant the Wiki's 10 XP only after a committed inventory change; equal or higher held cells do not yield free repeat XP. Cell/essence/stone/rune/talisman conversion is atomic, and a crafting action stops its talisman rolls after the first success.

Six workbench regressions pass, including repeated clicks and vanished inputs.
